propositions: A compacted authorship-ledger entry retains its pre-rewrite commit SHA, causing the verifier to misclassify authentic events after commit-history rewrite changes all SHAs while preserving tree and event positions.

The verifier must treat ledger commit_sha as a cache and prefer the current-history resolved commit when the ledger carries a position, falling back to the recorded SHA only when position resolution fails.
Live-event behavior, ledger wire format, persisted schema, and event bytes must remain unchanged after the fix.

A real-Git regression must prove a compacted ledger with non-null pre-rewrite SHAs maintains verified verdict after history rewrite with identical summary counts and multiset equality when commit SHAs are ignored.
